This violent impact released a global cloud of ash and sulfur that blocked vital solar light, initiating a prolonged volcanic winter that collapsed local food webs. Scientists confirmed this impact theory by discovering a distinct, globally distributed sediment layer containing high levels of iridium, an extremely rare element on Earth.

comprehension_question.question_text: How did scientists confirm the asteroid impact theory of dinosaur extinction?

options.text: By finding intact dinosaur DNA preserved inside ancient desert rocks.
By observing similar asteroid collisions on the surface of Mars.
By discovering a globally distributed sediment layer containing high levels of iridium.

comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: discovering a distinct, globally distributed sediment layer containing high levels of iridium
comprehension_question.why_correct: Son cümle bilim insanlarının dünya genelinde yüksek oranda iridyum içeren bir tortu tabakası keşfederek asteroit teorisini doğruladıklarını açıklar.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: What did the asteroid impact release that blocked solar light?

options.text: A cloud of ash and sulfur

comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: released a global cloud of ash and sulfur that blocked vital solar light
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: Metin "released a global cloud of ash and sulfur that blocked vital solar light" diyor; çarpma, güneş ışığını engelleyen küresel bir kül ve kükürt bulutu saldı.

paragraph_raw: Ocean acidification represents a highly destructive environmental consequence of global climate change, driven primarily by the absorption of excess atmospheric carbon dioxide into our oceans. When seawater absorbs this greenhouse gas, a chemical reaction occurs that forms carbonic acid and lowers the pH levels of the water. This increased acidity significantly reduces the availability of carbonate ions, which are vital building blocks that marine organisms like corals and shellfish need to build their protective shells. Without these essential ions, these vulnerable creatures grow fragile shells, leaving them highly exposed to ocean currents and predators.

comprehension_question.question_text: What happens when seawater absorbs excess atmospheric carbon dioxide?

options.text: It increases the oxygen levels of deep ocean waters, benefiting marine fish.
A chemical reaction occurs that forms carbonic acid and lowers the pH levels.
It turns seawater into a highly alkaline solution that prevents coral bleaching.

comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: chemical reaction occurs that forms carbonic acid and lowers the pH levels of the water
comprehension_question.why_correct: İkinci cümle deniz suyunun karbondioksiti emmesiyle karbonik asit oluştuğunu ve suyun pH seviyesinin düştüğünü belirtmektedir.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: What do vulnerable creatures grow without these essential ions?
comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: these vulnerable creatures grow fragile shells
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: Metin "these vulnerable creatures grow fragile shells" diyor; bu iyonlar olmadan savunmasız canlılar kırılgan kabuklar geliştirir.

paragraph_raw: During the early Renaissance, Italian artists revolutionized European painting by developing linear perspective, a mathematical system that creates a realistic illusion of three-dimensional depth on flat wooden panels. Filippo Brunelleschi, a brilliant Florentine architect, demonstrated this geometric method by using a vanishing point where all parallel lines in a painting appear to meet on the horizon. This mathematical innovation allowed painters to accurately represent architectural spaces and natural landscapes, moving away from flat medieval designs. Consequently, paintings became highly realistic windows into three-dimensional worlds, permanently transforming artistic standards across the continent.

comprehension_question.question_text: How did Filippo Brunelleschi demonstrate the geometric method of linear perspective?

options.text: By painting large historical battles on the ceilings of Florentine churches.
By combining medieval flat designs with expensive gold leaf frames.
By using a vanishing point where all parallel lines appear to meet on the horizon.

comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: using a vanishing point where all parallel lines in a painting appear to meet on the horizon
comprehension_question.why_correct: İkinci cümle Brunelleschi'nin tüm paralel çizgilerin ufukta birleştiği bir kaçış noktası kullanarak bu geometrik yöntemi gösterdiğini açıklar.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: What did this mathematical innovation allow painters to do?
comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: accurately represent architectural spaces and natural landscapes
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: Metin "accurately represent architectural spaces and natural landscapes" diyor; bu yenilik ressamların mimari mekânları ve doğal manzaraları doğru betimlemesini sağladı.

paragraph_raw: In recent decades, paleontology has undergone a major revolution due to the discovery of beautifully preserved fossilized dinosaur feathers in northeastern China. These remarkable discoveries have completely altered the traditional scientific view of dinosaurs as cold-blooded, scaly reptiles. Analysis of these fossil structures shows that many small predatory dinosaurs possessed primitive feathers long before the evolution of birds. Rather than being used for flight, these early feathers likely served as insulation to regulate body temperature or as colorful displays to attract mates. This fossil evidence strongly supports the modern scientific consensus that birds are living descendants of theropod dinosaurs.

comprehension_question.question_text: According to the text, what was the primary function of early dinosaur feathers?

options.text: They served as insulation to regulate body temperature or as colorful displays to attract mates.
They were used primarily to help large cold-blooded reptiles fly.
They protected fossilized dinosaur bones from cold temperatures in China.

comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: early feathers likely served as insulation to regulate body temperature or as colorful displays to attract mates
comprehension_question.why_correct: Beşinci cümle ilk tüylerin uçuş yerine vücut ısısını düzenlemek veya eşleri cezbetmek amacıyla kullanıldığını gösterir.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: What does this fossil evidence strongly support?
comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: birds are living descendants of theropod dinosaurs
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: Metin "birds are living descendants of theropod dinosaurs" diyor; bu kanıt kuşların theropod dinozorların torunları olduğunu güçlü biçimde destekler.

paragraph_raw: The rapid expansion of the digital gig economy has transformed traditional labor markets by replacing long-term contracts with flexible, short-term freelance tasks managed via mobile applications. While proponents praise this modern business model for offering workers exceptional schedule flexibility and autonomy, critics express concerns regarding the total absence of employer-provided benefits like health insurance, paid leaves, and retirement savings. Consequently, gig workers bear all financial risks themselves, facing immense income volatility. This labor shift has forced global policymakers to reconsider existing employment laws to protect these vulnerable independent contractors.

comprehension_question.question_text: What concern do critics express regarding the digital gig economy model?

options.text: The lack of mobile applications available for managing daily tasks.
The strict long-term contracts that prevent workers from changing jobs.
The total absence of employer-provided benefits like health insurance.

comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: total absence of employer-provided benefits like health insurance, paid leaves, and retirement savings
comprehension_question.why_correct: İkinci cümle eleştirmenlerin işveren tarafından sağlanan sağlık sigortası gibi sosyal hakların tamamen yoksun olmasından endişe duyduğunu gösterir.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: What do gig workers bear themselves as a result?
comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: gig workers bear all financial risks themselves, facing immense income volatility
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: Metin "gig workers bear all financial risks themselves, facing immense income volatility" diyor; sonuçta gig çalışanları tüm finansal riski üstlenir ve gelir dalgalanmasıyla yüzleşir.

paragraph_raw: Climatologists are highly concerned about the thawing of Arctic permafrost, which is the permanently frozen ground that covers vast areas of the northern hemisphere. This ancient soil contains massive quantities of organic carbon, accumulated from dead plants over thousands of years. As global temperatures rise, this frozen soil melts, allowing microbes to decompose the organic matter and release carbon dioxide and methane gases into the atmosphere. This release creates a dangerous positive feedback loop that accelerates global warming, leading to even faster permafrost melting across polar regions.

comprehension_question.question_text: What happens when Arctic permafrost melts due to rising global temperatures?

options.text: Microbes decompose organic matter and release carbon dioxide and methane gases.
It turns polar regions into rich agricultural lands that absorb carbon dioxide.
It completely freezes all nearby rivers, stopping water flow to the sea.

comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: soil melts, allowing microbes to decompose the organic matter and release carbon dioxide and methane gases
comprehension_question.why_correct: Üçüncü cümle donmuş toprağın erimesiyle mikropların organik maddeyi parçalayarak karbondioksit ve metan gazı saldığını açıklamaktadır.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: What kind of loop does this gas release create?
comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: creates a dangerous positive feedback loop that accelerates global warming
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: Metin "creates a dangerous positive feedback loop that accelerates global warming" diyor; bu gaz salımı küresel ısınmayı hızlandıran tehlikeli bir pozitif geri besleme döngüsü yaratır.

paragraph_raw: The development of CRISPR genetic engineering technology has revolutionized medical research by acting as precise molecular scissors that can edit DNA sequences within living cells. Derived from a natural defense mechanism in bacteria, CRISPR utilizes a specialized guiding molecule to locate a specific gene sequence and cut it cleanly. This precise cut allows scientists to remove harmful mutations or insert beneficial genetic material during the cell's natural DNA repair process. While this powerful tool offers potential cures for inherited diseases, it raises significant ethical concerns regarding the permanent modification of human embryos.

comprehension_question.question_text: How does CRISPR technology find and edit a specific gene sequence?

options.text: By injecting beneficial bacteria directly into the blood of patients.
By using a specialized guiding molecule to locate and cut the sequence.
By destroying all nearby healthy cells to stimulate natural DNA repair.

comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: CRISPR utilizes a specialized guiding molecule to locate a specific gene sequence and cut it cleanly
comprehension_question.why_correct: İkinci cümle CRISPR teknolojisinin belirli bir gen dizisini bulup kesmek için özel bir rehber molekül kullandığını belirtir.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: What potential does this powerful CRISPR tool offer?
comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: offers potential cures for inherited diseases
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: Metin "offers potential cures for inherited diseases" diyor; bu güçlü araç kalıtsal hastalıklar için potansiyel tedaviler sunar.

paragraph_raw: The discovery of the Terracotta Army in China remains one of the most remarkable archaeological events of the twentieth century. Unearthed by farmers in 1974, this vast underground collection contains thousands of life-sized clay soldiers, horses, and chariots buried near the tomb of the first Chinese emperor, Qin Shi Huang. Each statue features unique facial expressions and hairstyles, reflecting the incredible craftsmanship of ancient artisans. Archaeologists believe these clay figures were created to protect the emperor in the afterlife and demonstrate his imperial power. Ongoing excavations continue to reveal new chambers filled with ancient weapons and historical artifacts.

comprehension_question.question_text: According to archaeologists, what was the primary purpose of creating the clay figures?

options.text: To protect the emperor in the afterlife and demonstrate his imperial power.
To help farmers discover new underground water chambers in 1974.
To display the unique hairstyles of ancient artisans during imperial festivals.

comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: clay figures were created to protect the emperor in the afterlife and demonstrate his imperial power
comprehension_question.why_correct: Dördüncü cümle arkeologların bu kil figürlerin imparatoru ahirette korumak ve gücünü göstermek amacıyla yapıldığına inandıklarını gösterir.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: What unique features does each Terracotta statue have?
comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: Each statue features unique facial expressions and hairstyles
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: Metin "Each statue features unique facial expressions and hairstyles" diyor; her heykelin kendine özgü yüz ifadesi ve saç biçimi vardır.

paragraph_raw: Aerodynamics is a critical branch of engineering that studies how air interacts with solid objects, particularly wings in motion. According to Bernoulli's principle, the unique curved shape of an airplane wing forces air to travel faster over the top surface than underneath it. This speed difference creates lower air pressure on top, generating an upward lift force that allows heavy airplanes to overcome gravity and fly. Understanding these subtle pressure changes is essential for aerospace engineers to design highly fuel-efficient airplanes and exceptionally fast racing vehicles.

comprehension_question.question_text: How does an airplane wing generate lift according to the text?

options.text: By creating higher pressure on top of the wing than underneath it.
Wing curved shape forces air to travel faster over the top, creating lower pressure there.
By releasing compressed gas from jet engines directly beneath the wing.

comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: forces air to travel faster over the top surface than underneath it. This speed difference creates lower air pressure on top, generating an upward lift
comprehension_question.why_correct: Metindeki ikinci ve üçüncü cümleler kanadın şeklinden dolayı üstte düşük basınç oluştuğunu ve bunun kaldırma kuvveti yarattığını açıklar.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: What branch of engineering is described in the text?
comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: Aerodynamics is a critical branch of engineering that studies how air interacts with solid objects
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: Metin "Aerodynamics is a critical branch of engineering that studies how air interacts with solid objects" diyor; metin havanın katı cisimlerle etkileşimini inceleyen aerodinamiği anlatır.

paragraph_raw: A cognitive bias is a systematic pattern of deviation from norm or rationality in judgment, whereby individuals create their own subjective reality from their perception of the input. Confirmation bias is one of the most common types, where people actively search for, favor, and recall information that confirms their pre-existing beliefs. This bias often creates deep ideological echo chambers on modern social media platforms, where users only interact with like-minded individuals and dismiss alternative views. Recognizing these subconscious biases is vital for developing critical thinking and objective decision-making skills.

comprehension_question.question_text: What is confirmation bias as described in the text?

options.text: A physical memory disorder where people completely forget their childhood experiences.
An intentional strategy used by social media companies to block fake accounts.
A bias where people actively search for and favor information confirming their beliefs.

comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: where people actively search for, favor, and recall information that confirms their pre-existing beliefs
comprehension_question.why_correct: İkinci cümle doğrulama yanlılığını insanların kendi inanışlarını destekleyen bilgileri aktif olarak araması ve kayırması olarak tanımlar.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: What does confirmation bias create on modern social media?
comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: creates deep ideological echo chambers on modern social media platforms
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: Metin "creates deep ideological echo chambers on modern social media platforms" diyor; doğrulama önyargısı sosyal medyada derin ideolojik yankı odaları oluşturur.

paragraph_raw: Stonehenge is a prehistoric monument in England consisting of a ring of standing stones, built during the Neolithic and Bronze Ages. Archaeologists agree that the massive stones were carefully aligned to mark major astronomical events, particularly the summer solstice sunrise. However, how ancient builders transported these colossal bluestones from Wales, which is over one hundred miles away, remains a historical mystery. This monument likely served as an ancient ceremonial center and a burial site, demonstrating that prehistoric societies possessed advanced engineering skills and sophisticated astronomical knowledge.

comprehension_question.question_text: According to archaeologists, what was the primary purpose of Stonehenge's stone alignment?

options.text: To serve as a defensive fortress against invading continental armies.
To mark major astronomical events, particularly the summer solstice sunrise.
To store heavy grain supplies during long winter droughts.

comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: stones were carefully aligned to mark major astronomical events, particularly the summer solstice sunrise
comprehension_question.why_correct: İkinci cümle dikili taşların gökbilimsel olayları, özellikle yaz gündönümü gün doğumunu işaret etmek için hizalandığını belirtir.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: From where were the colossal bluestones transported?
comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: transported these colossal bluestones from Wales, which is over one hundred miles away
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: Metin "transported these colossal bluestones from Wales, which is over one hundred miles away" diyor; devasa mavi taşlar yüz milden uzaktaki Galler'den taşınmış.

paragraph_raw: A keystone species is an organism that plays a defining role in maintaining the structure of an ecological community, affecting many other organisms. The reintroduction of gray wolves to Yellowstone National Park demonstrated this concept by triggering a trophic cascade. By hunting excess elk, wolves allowed overgrazed willow and aspen trees along rivers to recover. This forest restoration provided vital nesting habitats for songbirds and building materials for beavers, who constructed dams that cooled the river waters for native trout. This complex network proves how a single predator can restore balance.

comprehension_question.question_text: What trophic cascade occurred after the reintroduction of gray wolves to Yellowstone?

options.text: Gray wolves ate all the native trout, leading to a collapse of river ecosystems.
Songbirds migrated away from the park due to the loud howling of wolf packs.
By hunting excess elk, wolves allowed overgrazed willow and aspen trees to recover.

comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: By hunting excess elk, wolves allowed overgrazed willow and aspen trees along rivers to recover
comprehension_question.why_correct: Üçüncü cümle kurtların aşırı elk geyiği nüfusunu avlayarak nehir kenarındaki ağaçların iyileşmesini sağladığını belirtir.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: What did the recovered willow and aspen trees provide?

options.text: Habitats for birds and materials for beavers

comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: provided vital nesting habitats for songbirds and building materials for beavers
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: Metin "provided vital nesting habitats for songbirds and building materials for beavers" diyor; toparlanan ağaçlar ötücü kuşlara yuva ve kunduzlara yapı malzemesi sağladı.

paragraph_raw: Many people struggle to fall asleep at night. Experts suggest a calm routine before bed. A warm bath and a boring book can be soporific, making the eyes heavy and the mind slow. Bright phone screens do the opposite. They keep the brain awake and delay sleep for hours.

options.text: They keep the brain awake and delay sleep
They help people read boring books

comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: They keep the brain awake and delay sleep for hours
comprehension_question.why_correct: Metin "They keep the brain awake and delay sleep for hours" diyor; parlak ekranlar beyni uyanık tutar ve uykuyu geciktirir.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: In the text, the word "soporific" most likely means:

paragraph_raw: Hospitals are places of healing, but they can also spread disease. Nosocomial infections are illnesses that patients catch while staying in a hospital. comprehension_question_2.question_text: How do doctors and nurses reduce the risk?
comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: reduce this risk by washing their hands often
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: Metin "reduce this risk by washing their hands often" diyor; doktor ve hemşireler sık el yıkayarak riski azaltır.

paragraph_raw: Water makes up more than half of the human body. When we sweat on hot days, we lose a lot of it. A parched mouth, dry and sticky, is often the first warning sign. Drinking small amounts of water throughout the day is better than drinking a large bottle at once.

Drinking small amounts of water all day

comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: A parched mouth, dry and sticky, is often the first warning sign

paragraph_raw: Daily walking is one of the easiest ways to stay fit. A thirty-minute walk strengthens the heart and improves mood. My grandfather walks every morning, and at ninety he is still hale, strong and full of energy. He says that walking keeps both his body and his mind young.

comprehension_question.why_correct: Metin "strengthens the heart and improves mood" diyor; yürüyüş kalbi güçlendirir ve ruh hâlini iyileştirir.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: What does the grandfather say walking does?

options.text: It keeps his body and mind young
It makes him tired all day

paragraph_raw: Sugar gives the body quick energy, but too much of it is deleterious. It damages teeth, adds extra weight and raises the risk of diabetes. Many soft drinks contain more than ten spoons of sugar. Choosing water or plain milk instead is a simple way to protect your health.

paragraph_raw: Sunlight helps the body make vitamin D, yet strong midday sun can be pernicious to the skin. Over many years, it quietly causes wrinkles, dark spots and even skin cancer. Doctors advise wearing sunscreen, a hat and sunglasses, especially between eleven in the morning and three in the afternoon.

comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: helps the body make vitamin D
comprehension_question.why_correct: Metin "Sunlight helps the body make vitamin D" diyor; güneş ışığı vücudun D vitamini üretmesine yardım eder.

comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: Over many years, it quietly causes wrinkles, dark spots and even skin cancer
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: "pernicious" = sinsice zarar veren; ipucu: "Over many years, it quietly causes..." — zarar yıllar içinde, sessizce gelir.

paragraph_raw: Skipping breakfast is a common habit among students. By noon, many of them feel famished and eat large amounts of fast food. A simple morning meal, such as eggs, bread and fruit, keeps hunger under control. It also helps students focus better during morning lessons.

comprehension_question.question_text: What else does a morning meal help students do?
comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: helps students focus better during morning lessons
comprehension_question.why_correct: Metin "It also helps students focus better during morning lessons" diyor; kahvaltı sabah derslerinde odaklanmayı artırır.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: In the text, the word "famished" most likely means:

paragraph_raw: Antibiotics are among the greatest achievements of modern medicine, yet their profligate use now threatens their power. Doctors often prescribe them for colds and flu, which are caused by viruses, not bacteria. Farmers also give huge quantities to healthy animals to make them grow faster. Every unnecessary dose gives bacteria another chance to adapt, and resistant strains are spreading faster than new drugs can be developed.

comprehension_question.question_text: Why is prescribing antibiotics for colds a mistake?

options.text: Colds are caused by viruses, not bacteria
Colds are caused by resistant bacteria

comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: which are caused by viruses, not bacteria
comprehension_question.why_correct: Metin soğuk algınlığı ve grip için "which are caused by viruses, not bacteria" diyor; antibiyotik bakteriye etki eder, virüse değil.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: In the text, the word "profligate" most likely means:
comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: their profligate use now threatens their power
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: "profligate" = savurgan, aşırı; metin örnekleri sayar: gribe reçete, sağlıklı hayvanlara "huge quantities" ve "Every unnecessary dose" — yani gereksiz ve bol kullanım.

paragraph_raw: Short periods of stress can actually help us, for example by sharpening our attention before an exam. Long-term stress is different: it weakens the immune system and disturbs sleep. People who practise meditation or regular exercise often face problems with greater equanimity, remaining calm and balanced when others panic. Researchers believe this calmness is a skill that anyone can develop with patience and practice.

comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: by sharpening our attention before an exam
comprehension_question.why_correct: Metin kısa süreli stresin "sharpening our attention before an exam" yoluyla işe yaradığını söyler; dikkati keskinleştirir.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: What do researchers believe about this calmness?

options.text: It is a skill anyone can develop
People are simply born with it

comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: this calmness is a skill that anyone can develop
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: Metin "this calmness is a skill that anyone can develop" diyor; araştırmacılara göre bu sakinlik herkesin geliştirebileceği bir beceridir.

paragraph_raw: Dietary fibre, found in beans, oats and vegetables, does far more than help digestion. Because it absorbs water and expands in the stomach, it creates a lasting sense of satiety, so people feel full for hours and snack less. Fibre also slows the release of sugar into the blood. Despite these benefits, most adults eat only half the amount that nutrition experts recommend.

comprehension_question.why_correct: "satiety" = tokluk hissi; ipucu hemen ardında: "so people feel full for hours and snack less" (saatlerce tok hisseder, az atıştırır).

comprehension_question_2.question_text: How much fibre do most adults eat?
comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: most adults eat only half the amount that nutrition experts recommend
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: Metin "most adults eat only half the amount that nutrition experts recommend" diyor; yetişkinlerin çoğu önerilen miktarın yalnızca yarısını yer.

paragraph_raw: Measles was once close to disappearing in many wealthy countries thanks to widespread vaccination. In recent years, however, falling vaccination rates have led to a recrudescence of the disease, with outbreaks returning to cities that had not seen a case in decades. Health officials warn that when fewer than ninety-five percent of children are vaccinated, the virus can easily find new victims.

comprehension_question.question_text: What caused the problem described in the text?
comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: falling vaccination rates have led to
comprehension_question.why_correct: Metin "falling vaccination rates have led to" diyor; sorunun sebebi düşen aşılama oranlarıdır.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: In the text, the word "recrudescence" most likely means:

options.text: a return of a disease after a quiet period
the complete end of a disease
a new cure found by scientists

comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: with outbreaks returning to cities that had not seen a case in decades
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: "recrudescence" = hastalığın yeniden alevlenmesi; ipucu: "outbreaks returning to cities that had not seen a case in decades" — onlarca yıldır vaka görmeyen şehirlere salgın geri döner.

paragraph_raw: Hours spent bent over phones and laptops are changing the way people carry their bodies. Many young adults now have a stooped posture, with rounded shoulders and a head pushed forward like an old man's. This position puts heavy pressure on the neck and can cause chronic pain. Physiotherapists recommend raising screens to eye level and taking a short stretching break every half hour.

comprehension_question.question_text: What do physiotherapists recommend?

options.text: Using phones only while lying down
Avoiding all movement of the neck
Raising screens to eye level and stretching often

comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: raising screens to eye level and taking a short stretching break every half hour
comprehension_question.why_correct: Metin "raising screens to eye level and taking a short stretching break every half hour" diyor; ekranı göz hizasına kaldırmak ve yarım saatte bir esnemek önerilir.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: What problem can this posture cause?

options.text: Heavy pressure on the neck and chronic pain

comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: puts heavy pressure on the neck and can cause chronic pain
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: Metin "puts heavy pressure on the neck and can cause chronic pain" diyor; bu duruş boyna yük bindirir ve kronik ağrı yapabilir.

paragraph_raw: New memories are surprisingly evanescent. Without review, most of what we hear in a lecture fades within a few days, like footprints in the sand. The brain strengthens a memory each time we recall it, especially when the recall is spread over several days. This is why students who test themselves regularly remember far more than those who simply reread their notes the night before an exam.

comprehension_question.question_text: According to the text, which students remember more?

options.text: Those who reread notes the night before
Those who attend only one lecture

comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: students who test themselves regularly remember far more
comprehension_question.why_correct: Metin "students who test themselves regularly remember far more" diyor; kendini düzenli sınayan öğrenciler çok daha fazla hatırlar.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: In the text, the word "evanescent" most likely means:
comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: most of what we hear in a lecture fades within a few days, like footprints in the sand
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: "evanescent" = çabuk kaybolan; ipucu: "fades within a few days, like footprints in the sand" — kumdaki ayak izi gibi birkaç günde silinir.

paragraph_raw: City dwellers live surrounded by a constant cacophony of car horns, construction drills and shouting voices. Scientists now link this harsh mixture of sounds to serious health problems. Long exposure to traffic noise raises blood pressure and increases the risk of heart disease, even when people claim they no longer notice it. Some cities are responding by planting trees along busy roads and building quieter pavements.

comprehension_question.question_text: In the text, the word "cacophony" most likely means:

options.text: a harsh mixture of loud sounds

comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: a constant cacophony of car horns, construction drills and shouting voices
comprehension_question.why_correct: "cacophony" = kulak tırmalayıcı gürültü; örnekler (korna, matkap, bağırış) ve sonraki cümledeki "this harsh mixture of sounds" anlamı verir.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: How are some cities responding?

options.text: By banning all cars from the center
By planting trees and building quieter pavements

comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: planting trees along busy roads and building quieter pavements
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: Metin "planting trees along busy roads and building quieter pavements" diyor; bazı şehirler ağaç dikip daha sessiz kaldırımlar yapıyor.

paragraph_raw: The placebo effect remains one of the most puzzling phenomena in medicine. In numerous trials, patients who received sham treatments, such as sugar pills or fake injections containing no active ingredient, reported genuine reductions in pain. Brain scans suggest that the mere expectation of relief can trigger the release of natural painkillers. Remarkably, some studies show that placebos work even when patients are told openly that the pills are fake. Researchers therefore argue that the ritual of care itself, including a doctor's attention and reassurance, may contribute to healing.

comprehension_question.question_text: What is remarkable about some placebo studies?

options.text: Placebos worked even when patients knew the pills were fake

comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: placebos work even when patients are told openly that the pills are fake
comprehension_question.why_correct: Metin "placebos work even when patients are told openly that the pills are fake" diyor; hap sahte olduğu açıkça söylense bile plasebo işe yarayabiliyor.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: In the text, the word "sham" most likely means:
comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: sham treatments, such as sugar pills or fake injections containing no active ingredient
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: "sham" = sahte, göstermelik; örnekler anlamı verir: "sugar pills or fake injections containing no active ingredient" (şeker hap, etken madde içermeyen sahte iğne).

paragraph_raw: Ultra-processed foods, which include packaged snacks, sugary cereals and ready meals, now provide more than half of the calories consumed in several developed countries. These products are engineered to be extremely tasty and cheap, but they often lack fibre and essential nutrients. Manufacturers also add sugar surreptitiously, hiding it on labels under unfamiliar names such as dextrose or maltose so that shoppers rarely notice it. Large studies have associated diets rich in such foods with obesity, depression and early death, although scientists are still debating which ingredients cause the most harm.

comprehension_question.question_text: What are scientists still debating?

options.text: Which ingredients cause the most harm

comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: scientists are still debating which ingredients cause the most harm
comprehension_question.why_correct: Metin "scientists are still debating which ingredients cause the most harm" diyor; tartışma, en çok zararı hangi bileşenin verdiği üzerinedir.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: In the text, the word "surreptitiously" most likely means:
comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: add sugar surreptitiously, hiding it on labels under unfamiliar names
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: "surreptitiously" = gizlice; ipucu: "hiding it on labels under unfamiliar names ... so that shoppers rarely notice it" — şekeri tanıdık olmayan adlar altında saklarlar.

paragraph_raw: During deep sleep, the brain performs a remarkable cleaning process. Cerebrospinal fluid flows through narrow channels between brain cells and washes away metabolic detritus, the chemical waste left behind by a full day of mental activity. One of these waste products is a protein that forms harmful plaques in patients with Alzheimer's disease. Experiments on mice showed that this cleaning system works up to ten times faster during sleep than during waking hours. Such findings may explain why chronic sleep deprivation is linked to a higher risk of memory problems later in life.

comprehension_question.question_text: In the text, the word "detritus" most likely means:
comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: washes away metabolic detritus, the chemical waste left behind
comprehension_question.why_correct: "detritus" = döküntü, atık; virgülden sonra gelen açıklama anlamı verir: "the chemical waste left behind by a full day of mental activity".

comprehension_question_2.question_text: How much faster does the cleaning system work during sleep in mice?
comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: works up to ten times faster during sleep
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: Metin "this cleaning system works up to ten times faster during sleep" diyor; farelerde temizlik uykuda on kata kadar hızlı işler.

paragraph_raw: Before the discovery of anaesthesia in the 1840s, surgery was a harrowing experience that many patients feared more than death itself. Fully awake, they were held down by strong assistants while surgeons cut as quickly as possible; the best surgeons could remove a leg in under a minute. Survivors often described the memory as the most terrifying moment of their lives. The first public demonstration of ether in Boston changed everything, allowing surgeons to work slowly and carefully, which in turn made far more complex operations possible.

comprehension_question.question_text: How did anaesthesia change surgery?

options.text: Patients could stay awake and watch
Surgeons could work slowly and carefully
Operations had to finish in under a minute

comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: allowing surgeons to work slowly and carefully
comprehension_question.why_correct: Metin eterin "allowing surgeons to work slowly and carefully" sağladığını söyler; cerrahlar yavaş ve dikkatli çalışabildi.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: In the text, the word "harrowing" most likely means:
comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: Survivors often described the memory as the most terrifying moment of their lives
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: "harrowing" = dehşet verici; ipucu: hastalar ondan "more than death itself" korkar ve hayatta kalanlar onu "the most terrifying moment of their lives" diye anlatır.

paragraph_raw: For centuries, doctors believed that diseases such as cholera were spread by miasma, a poisonous cloud of foul-smelling air rising from rotting waste and dirty water. In 1854, the London physician John Snow challenged this idea. By marking every cholera death on a map, he noticed that the victims clustered around a single public water pump on Broad Street. When the handle of the pump was removed, new cases quickly declined. Although many experts rejected his conclusions at the time, Snow's work later became a founding example of modern epidemiology.

hard_word.tr: kötü hava, pis kokulu zehirli buhar

comprehension_question.question_text: What did John Snow notice on his map?

options.text: The victims clustered around one water pump
The victims lived near rotting waste
The victims were spread evenly across London

comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: the victims clustered around a single public water pump
comprehension_question.why_correct: Metin "the victims clustered around a single public water pump" diyor; ölümler tek bir su pompasının çevresinde toplanmıştı.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: What happened when the pump handle was removed?

options.text: The disease spread to other streets

comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: new cases quickly declined
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: Metin "When the handle of the pump was removed, new cases quickly declined" diyor; pompa kolu sökülünce yeni vakalar hızla azaldı.

paragraph_raw: Chronic pain, defined as pain lasting longer than three months, affects roughly one in five adults worldwide. Unlike acute pain, which warns us of injury, chronic pain often continues long after tissues have healed, because the nervous system itself becomes oversensitive. Strong opioid drugs may assuage the suffering for a while, but their effect weakens over time and the risk of addiction is high. For this reason, many clinics now combine gentle exercise, psychological therapy and education, an approach that eases pain without creating new dangers.

comprehension_question.question_text: Why does chronic pain continue after tissues heal?

options.text: The injury stays open for months

comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: because the nervous system itself becomes oversensitive
comprehension_question.why_correct: Metin "because the nervous system itself becomes oversensitive" diyor; doku iyileşse de sinir sistemi aşırı hassaslaştığı için ağrı sürer.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: In the text, the word "assuage" most likely means:
comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: may assuage the suffering for a while, but their effect weakens
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: "assuage" = hafifletmek; ipucu: "for a while, but their effect weakens over time" (bir süre işe yarar, sonra etkisi azalır); paragraf sonunda eş anlamlısı "eases pain" gelir.

paragraph_raw: Good teeth need daily care. My dentist is fastidious: she checks every tooth twice and notices even the smallest spot. She tells her patients to brush for two full minutes, morning and night. She also warns that sugary snacks between meals are the main enemy of healthy teeth.

comprehension_question.question_text: In the text, the word "fastidious" most likely means:
comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: she checks every tooth twice and notices even the smallest spot
comprehension_question.why_correct: "fastidious" = titiz; iki noktadan sonraki açıklama anlamı verir: "she checks every tooth twice and notices even the smallest spot".

comprehension_question_2.question_text: What does the dentist call the main enemy of healthy teeth?
comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: sugary snacks between meals are the main enemy of healthy teeth
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: Metin "sugary snacks between meals are the main enemy of healthy teeth" diyor; öğün arası şekerli atıştırmalıklar dişlerin baş düşmanıdır.

paragraph_raw: Cigarette smoke contains thousands of chemicals, and many of them cause cancer. The acrid smell, sharp and bitter, stays in clothes, hair and furniture for days. Children who live with smokers breathe in this smoke too. They get more coughs and ear infections than other children.

comprehension_question.question_text: What problems do children of smokers have more often?
comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: They get more coughs and ear infections than other children
comprehension_question.why_correct: Metin "They get more coughs and ear infections than other children" diyor; sigara içilen evdeki çocuklar daha sık öksürük ve kulak enfeksiyonu geçirir.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: Where does the smell of smoke stay?
comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: stays in clothes, hair and furniture for days
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: Metin kokunun "stays in clothes, hair and furniture for days" dediğini söyler; koku günlerce giysi, saç ve mobilyada kalır.

paragraph_raw: An allergy happens when the immune system attacks something innocuous, such as pollen or cat hair, as if it were a dangerous invader. The body then produces sneezing, itchy eyes or a runny nose. Allergies are becoming more common in cities. Some scientists think very clean homes may be one reason.

comprehension_question.question_text: What do some scientists think may be one reason for more allergies?
comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: very clean homes may be one reason
comprehension_question.why_correct: Metin "Some scientists think very clean homes may be one reason" diyor; bazı bilim insanlarına göre çok temiz evler bir sebep olabilir.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: In the text, the word "innocuous" most likely means:
comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: attacks something innocuous, such as pollen or cat hair, as if it were a dangerous invader
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: "innocuous" = zararsız; ipucu: "as if it were a dangerous invader" — sanki tehlikeli bir istilacıymış gibi; yani aslında tehlikeli değil.

paragraph_raw: Myopia is spreading fast among children. A child with this condition can read a book easily, but the board at school looks blurry. Doctors believe that too much time on screens and too little time outdoors are the main causes. Two hours of daylight each day may protect young eyes.

comprehension_question.question_text: In the text, the word "myopia" most likely means:

options.text: difficulty seeing things that are far away
difficulty reading small print up close
pain in the eyes at night

comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: can read a book easily, but the board at school looks blurry
comprehension_question.why_correct: "myopia" = miyopluk; ipucu: "can read a book easily, but the board at school looks blurry" — yakındaki kitap net, uzaktaki tahta bulanık.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: What may protect young eyes?

options.text: Two hours of daylight each day

comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: Two hours of daylight each day may protect young eyes
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: Metin "Two hours of daylight each day may protect young eyes" diyor; günde iki saat gün ışığı çocuk gözlerini koruyabilir.

paragraph_raw: A fever is not an illness in itself. It is the body's way of fighting germs, because many viruses cannot grow well at high temperatures. A febrile child feels hot, looks tired and often shivers. Parents should give plenty of water and call a doctor if the temperature stays above thirty-nine degrees.

comprehension_question.question_text: Why does the body produce a fever?

options.text: It removes water from the body
Many viruses cannot grow well at high temperatures

comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: many viruses cannot grow well at high temperatures
comprehension_question.why_correct: Metin "many viruses cannot grow well at high temperatures" diyor; ateş, virüslerin yüksek sıcaklıkta iyi çoğalamamasından yararlanan bir savunmadır.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: When should parents call a doctor?

options.text: As soon as the child shivers
If the temperature stays above thirty-nine degrees
If the child drinks a lot of water

comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: call a doctor if the temperature stays above thirty-nine degrees
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: Metin "call a doctor if the temperature stays above thirty-nine degrees" diyor; ateş otuz dokuzun üstünde kalırsa doktor aranmalı.

paragraph_raw: Heavy bleeding from an arm or leg can kill a person within minutes. First, press hard on the wound with a clean cloth. If the blood does not stop, a tight band called a tourniquet can be tied above the wound to cut off the flow. Then call an ambulance immediately.

options.text: Press hard on the wound with a clean cloth

comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: press hard on the wound with a clean cloth
comprehension_question.why_correct: Metin "First, press hard on the wound with a clean cloth" diyor; ilk adım yaraya temiz bir bezle sıkıca bastırmaktır.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: Where should the tight band be tied?
comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: tied above the wound to cut off the flow
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: Metin bandın "tied above the wound to cut off the flow" olduğunu söyler; akışı kesmek için yaranın üstüne bağlanır.

paragraph_raw: Iron helps red blood cells carry oxygen around the body. People who are anaemic do not have enough of these healthy cells, so they often look pale and feel weak after climbing a few stairs. Red meat, lentils and spinach are good sources of iron. Vitamin C helps the body absorb it.

comprehension_question.question_text: What helps the body absorb iron?
comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: Vitamin C helps the body absorb it
comprehension_question.why_correct: Metin "Vitamin C helps the body absorb it" diyor; C vitamini demirin emilmesine yardım eder.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: In the text, the word "anaemic" most likely means:

options.text: lacking enough healthy red blood cells

comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: do not have enough of these healthy cells, so they often look pale and feel weak
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: "anaemic" = kansız; ipucu: "do not have enough of these healthy cells" ve sonucu "look pale and feel weak" (solgun ve halsiz).

paragraph_raw: Heart attacks rarely happen without warning. Over many years, fatty deposits slowly build up inside the arteries and can eventually occlude them, blocking the flow of blood to the heart muscle. Without oxygen, part of the muscle begins to die within minutes. Smoking, high blood pressure and a lack of exercise all speed up this process, while a diet rich in vegetables and whole grains helps to slow it down.

comprehension_question.question_text: What happens to the heart muscle without oxygen?

options.text: Part of it begins to die within minutes

comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: part of the muscle begins to die within minutes
comprehension_question.why_correct: Metin "Without oxygen, part of the muscle begins to die within minutes" diyor; oksijensiz kalan kas dakikalar içinde ölmeye başlar.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: In the text, the word "occlude" most likely means:
comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: can eventually occlude them, blocking the flow of blood
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: "occlude" = tıkamak; ipucu virgülden sonra: "blocking the flow of blood" (kan akışını engelleyerek).

paragraph_raw: Type 2 diabetes often develops quietly over several years. Early symptoms include an insatiable thirst that no amount of water seems to satisfy, frequent trips to the toilet and unexplained tiredness. Because these signs appear slowly, many people ignore them until serious damage has already occurred. Regular blood tests after the age of forty can detect the disease early, when changes in diet and activity are most effective.

comprehension_question.question_text: In the text, the word "insatiable" most likely means:
comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: an insatiable thirst that no amount of water seems to satisfy
comprehension_question.why_correct: "insatiable" = doyumsuz, giderilemeyen; ipucu: "that no amount of water seems to satisfy" — ne kadar su içilse de geçmeyen susuzluk.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: Why do many people ignore the early signs?
comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: Because these signs appear slowly, many people ignore them
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: Metin "Because these signs appear slowly, many people ignore them" diyor; belirtiler yavaş geldiği için göz ardı edilir.

paragraph_raw: Trillions of bacteria live in the human gut, and most of them are commensal organisms that share our food without causing any harm. In return, they help us digest fibre, produce certain vitamins and train the immune system. When antibiotics or a poor diet reduce their variety, harmful species can take over. Eating fermented foods such as yoghurt and a wide range of vegetables supports a healthy community.

hard_word.tr: ortak yaşar, zarar vermeden birlikte yaşayan

comprehension_question.question_text: What can happen when antibiotics reduce bacterial variety?
comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: harmful species can take over
comprehension_question.why_correct: Metin çeşitlilik azalınca "harmful species can take over" diyor; zararlı türler baskın hâle gelebilir.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: In the text, the word "commensal" most likely means:

options.text: living with another organism without harming it

comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: commensal organisms that share our food without causing any harm
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: "commensal" = zarar vermeden birlikte yaşayan; ipucu: "that share our food without causing any harm".

paragraph_raw: Loneliness is increasingly recognised as a public health problem. Researchers have found that long-term social isolation is as harmful as smoking fifteen cigarettes a day. Elderly people who live alone are especially at risk; many describe feeling forlorn, as if the world has forgotten them. Simple programmes that connect volunteers with older neighbours for weekly phone calls have been shown to improve both mood and physical health.

comprehension_question.question_text: According to researchers, long-term isolation is as harmful as what?
comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: as harmful as smoking fifteen cigarettes a day
comprehension_question.why_correct: Metin uzun süreli yalnızlığın "as harmful as smoking fifteen cigarettes a day" olduğunu söyler; günde on beş sigara kadar zararlıdır.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: What have the weekly phone call programmes improved?
comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: improve both mood and physical health
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: Metin bu programların "improve both mood and physical health" dediğini söyler; hem ruh hâli hem beden sağlığı iyileşir.

paragraph_raw: Millions of young people listen to music through earphones at dangerous volumes. Over time, loud sound damages the tiny hair cells in the inner ear, which never grow back. One early sign is tinnitus, a ringing or buzzing noise that the person hears even in a completely silent room. Experts recommend the sixty-sixty rule: no more than sixty percent volume for no longer than sixty minutes at a time.

comprehension_question.question_text: What is true about the hair cells in the inner ear?

options.text: They grow back after a few weeks
Loud sound does not affect them
They never grow back once damaged

comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: which never grow back
comprehension_question.why_correct: Metin iç kulaktaki tüy hücreleri için "which never grow back" diyor; hasar görürlerse bir daha yenilenmezler.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: In the text, the word "tinnitus" most likely means:

options.text: a ringing sound heard in the ears
an infection of the outer ear

comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: a ringing or buzzing noise that the person hears even in a completely silent room
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: "tinnitus" = kulak çınlaması; virgülden sonra tanımlanır: "a ringing or buzzing noise that the person hears even in a completely silent room".

paragraph_raw: Scientists who study ageing are paying close attention to senescence, the process by which cells stop dividing but refuse to die. These so-called zombie cells gather in older tissues and release chemicals that damage their healthy neighbours. In experiments, removing them from elderly mice improved their strength and extended their lives. Similar drugs are now being tested in humans, although it is too early to know whether they are safe.

comprehension_question.question_text: What happened when zombie cells were removed from old mice?

options.text: The mice became stronger and lived longer

comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: improved their strength and extended their lives
comprehension_question.why_correct: Metin "removing them from elderly mice improved their strength and extended their lives" diyor; fareler güçlendi ve daha uzun yaşadı.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: What do zombie cells do in older tissues?

options.text: Release chemicals that damage healthy cells

comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: release chemicals that damage their healthy neighbours
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: Metin "release chemicals that damage their healthy neighbours" diyor; zombi hücreler komşu sağlıklı hücrelere zarar veren kimyasallar salar.

paragraph_raw: In large countries, millions of people live in the hinterland, far from cities and hospitals, where the nearest specialist may be a day's journey away. Telemedicine is changing this. Using a smartphone camera, a village nurse can now show a skin problem or an X-ray to a doctor hundreds of kilometres away. Poor internet connections, however, still limit how widely the service can be used.

comprehension_question.question_text: In the text, the word "hinterland" most likely means:
comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: live in the hinterland, far from cities and hospitals
comprehension_question.why_correct: "hinterland" = şehirlerden uzak iç bölgeler; ipucu hemen ardında: "far from cities and hospitals" ve "a day's journey away".

comprehension_question_2.question_text: What still limits telemedicine?

options.text: A lack of smartphones among doctors

comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: Poor internet connections, however, still limit
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: Metin "Poor internet connections, however, still limit how widely the service can be used" diyor; zayıf internet bağlantısı hâlâ bir engeldir.

paragraph_raw: For centuries, scurvy killed more sailors than storms, battles and shipwrecks combined. On long voyages, the first signs usually appeared after about two months at sea: a strange lassitude that left strong men too weak and tired to climb the ropes, followed by bleeding gums and old wounds that reopened. In 1747, the Scottish doctor James Lind showed that citrus fruit could cure the disease, yet the British navy took almost fifty years to supply lemon juice to its crews. We now know that scurvy is caused by a lack of vitamin C.

comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: took almost fifty years to supply lemon juice

paragraph_raw: Ideas about the healthy body have changed dramatically over time. In seventeenth-century Europe, a corpulent figure, with a round belly and heavy cheeks, signalled wealth, because only the rich could afford to eat large amounts of meat and sugar. Thin people, by contrast, were often assumed to be poor or sick. Today the situation has largely reversed in developed countries: cheap, energy-dense food has made obesity more common among low-income groups, while slimness has become a symbol of the time and money needed for exercise and fresh produce.

comprehension_question.question_text: Why did a large body signal wealth in seventeenth-century Europe?

options.text: Rich people never had to work
Only the rich could afford much meat and sugar

comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: only the rich could afford to eat large amounts of meat and sugar
comprehension_question.why_correct: Metin "only the rich could afford to eat large amounts of meat and sugar" diyor; bol et ve şekere yalnız zenginlerin gücü yetiyordu.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: What does slimness symbolise today, according to the text?

options.text: The time and money for exercise and fresh food
A love of meat and sugar

comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: slimness has become a symbol of the time and money needed for exercise and fresh produce
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: Metin "slimness has become a symbol of the time and money needed for exercise and fresh produce" diyor; zayıflık bugün spor ve taze gıdaya ayrılan zaman ve paranın simgesi.

paragraph_raw: Nicotine is one of the most addictive substances known, which explains why most smokers need several attempts before they finally quit. Even inveterate smokers, who have smoked a pack a day for thirty or forty years, can gain significant benefits from stopping. Within a year, their risk of heart disease falls by half, and after fifteen years it is similar to that of someone who has never smoked. Combining nicotine patches with regular counselling doubles the chance of success compared with willpower alone.

comprehension_question.question_text: In the text, the word "inveterate" most likely means:

options.text: having a long habit that is hard to change

comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: inveterate smokers, who have smoked a pack a day for thirty or forty years
comprehension_question.why_correct: "inveterate" = müzmin, iflah olmaz; ipucu: "who have smoked a pack a day for thirty or forty years" — kırk yıllık, kökleşmiş bir alışkanlık.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: What doubles the chance of quitting successfully?
comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: Combining nicotine patches with regular counselling doubles the chance of success
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: Metin "Combining nicotine patches with regular counselling doubles the chance of success" diyor; nikotin bandı ile düzenli danışmanlık başarı şansını ikiye katlar.

paragraph_raw: The influenza pandemic of 1918 infected about a third of the world's population and killed at least fifty million people. Its first wave, in the spring, was relatively mild, but the second wave that autumn was far more virulent, killing previously healthy young adults within days of their first symptoms. Scientists believe that in many of these victims the immune system overreacted, filling the lungs with fluid. Because wartime governments censored newspapers, the public received little reliable information, which allowed the virus to spread through crowded military camps and cities.

comprehension_question.question_text: Why did the public receive little reliable information?

options.text: There were no newspapers at the time

comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: Because wartime governments censored newspapers
comprehension_question.why_correct: Metin "Because wartime governments censored newspapers, the public received little reliable information" diyor; savaş hükümetleri gazeteleri sansürlediği için halk güvenilir bilgi alamadı.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: In the text, the word "virulent" most likely means:
comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: was relatively mild, but the second wave that autumn was far more virulent, killing previously healthy young adults
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: "virulent" = çok şiddetli, öldürücü; ipucu karşıtlıkta: ilk dalga "relatively mild, but" ikincisi daha "virulent" ve sağlıklı gençleri günler içinde öldürüyor.

paragraph_raw: After the age of about forty, adults lose a small percentage of their muscle mass every year. This gradual decline, known as sarcopenia, accelerates after seventy and is one of the main reasons why elderly people fall, break bones and lose their independence. The good news is that the process is not inevitable. Studies show that even people in their nineties can double their leg strength within a few months by lifting weights twice a week, provided they also eat enough protein to help the muscles rebuild.

comprehension_question.question_text: What can people in their nineties achieve by lifting weights?

options.text: Double their leg strength in a few months

comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: can double their leg strength within a few months
comprehension_question.why_correct: Metin doksanlı yaşlardaki kişilerin bile "can double their leg strength within a few months" dediğini söyler; birkaç ayda bacak gücünü ikiye katlayabilir.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: When does the decline speed up?
comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: accelerates after seventy
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: Metin bu kaybın "accelerates after seventy" dediğini söyler; kas kaybı yetmişten sonra hızlanır.

paragraph_raw: Alcohol affects the brain long before a person feels drunk. Even mildly inebriated drivers, who may insist that they feel perfectly normal, react more slowly, misjudge distances and find it harder to watch the road and the mirrors at the same time. For this reason, many countries have lowered the legal blood alcohol limit, and some ban drinking completely for new drivers during their first years on the road. Research shows that such strict limits reduce deaths among young drivers, who are already at higher risk because of their lack of experience.

comprehension_question.question_text: In the text, the word "inebriated" most likely means:
comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: Alcohol affects the brain long before a person feels drunk. Even mildly inebriated drivers
comprehension_question.why_correct: "inebriated" = sarhoş, alkollü; ipucu önceki cümlede: "long before a person feels drunk" ve metnin geri kalanındaki "blood alcohol limit".

comprehension_question_2.question_text: Why are young drivers already at higher risk?
comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: because of their lack of experience
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: Metin genç sürücülerin "because of their lack of experience" daha riskli olduğunu söyler; deneyimsizlik riski zaten artırır.

paragraph_raw: The common cold is caused by more than two hundred different viruses. It usually begins with a sore throat and a general malaise, a vague feeling of being unwell and low in energy. There is no cure, and antibiotics do not help. Rest, warm drinks and time are the best treatment.

comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: more than two hundred different viruses
comprehension_question.why_correct: Metin soğuk algınlığının "more than two hundred different viruses" ile oluştuğunu söyler; iki yüzden fazla virüs neden olabilir.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: In the text, the word "malaise" most likely means:

options.text: a sharp pain in one place
a general feeling of being unwell

comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: a general malaise, a vague feeling of being unwell and low in energy
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: "malaise" = keyifsizlik, genel halsizlik; virgülden sonra açıklanır: "a vague feeling of being unwell and low in energy".

paragraph_raw: Laughter is good medicine. When a room fills with mirth, people relax, their muscles loosen and stress hormones fall. Laughing also increases blood flow and may protect the heart. Best of all, it spreads easily: we laugh thirty times more often with friends than when we are alone.

comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: we laugh thirty times more often with friends
comprehension_question.why_correct: Metin "we laugh thirty times more often with friends than when we are alone" diyor; arkadaşlarla otuz kat daha sık güleriz.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: What may laughing protect?
comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: may protect the heart
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: Metin "Laughing also increases blood flow and may protect the heart" diyor; gülmek kalbi koruyabilir.

paragraph_raw: Gentle stretching every morning keeps the body supple, so you can bend, twist and reach without pain. Stiff muscles, on the other hand, are easily injured. Just ten minutes a day is enough. Move slowly, breathe deeply and never stretch until it hurts. Many older adults say it makes daily tasks much easier.

comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: Just ten minutes a day is enough
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: Metin "Just ten minutes a day is enough" diyor; günde on dakika yeterlidir.

paragraph_raw: Most headaches are caused by stress, tiredness or not drinking enough water. A migraine is different. It brings a throbbing pain, beating like a drum on one side of the head, and bright light can make it worse. Many sufferers need to lie down in a dark, quiet room until it passes.

comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: a throbbing pain, beating like a drum
comprehension_question.why_correct: "throbbing" = zonklayan; ipucu: "beating like a drum" — davul gibi vuran, ritimli bir ağrı.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: What do many migraine sufferers need to do?

options.text: Lie down in a dark, quiet room

comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: lie down in a dark, quiet room
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: Metin "Many sufferers need to lie down in a dark, quiet room until it passes" diyor; migren geçene kadar karanlık, sessiz bir odada uzanmak gerekir.

paragraph_raw: At holiday dinners, many people gorge on food, filling their plates again and again until they can hardly move. The stomach needs about twenty minutes to tell the brain that it is full. Eating slowly, using smaller plates and drinking water during the meal can help us stop in time.

options.text: Eating slowly and using smaller plates

comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: Eating slowly, using smaller plates and drinking water during the meal
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: Metin "Eating slowly, using smaller plates and drinking water during the meal can help us stop in time" diyor; yavaş yemek ve küçük tabak kullanmak zamanında durmaya yardım eder.

paragraph_raw: A cup of coffee in the morning helps many people wake up and concentrate. But too much caffeine can leave you jittery, with shaking hands and a racing heart. It can also ruin your sleep if you drink it late in the day. Most experts say four cups a day is the safe limit for adults.

comprehension_question.question_text: What is the safe limit for adults, according to most experts?
comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: four cups a day is the safe limit for adults
comprehension_question.why_correct: Metin "four cups a day is the safe limit for adults" diyor; uzmanlara göre günde dört fincan güvenli sınırdır.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: When can coffee ruin your sleep?

options.text: If you drink it with milk
If you drink it in the morning
If you drink it late in the day

comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: ruin your sleep if you drink it late in the day
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: Metin kahvenin "ruin your sleep if you drink it late in the day" dediğini söyler; günün geç saatinde içilirse uykuyu bozar.

paragraph_raw: In 1796, the English doctor Edward Jenner noticed that milkmaids who had caught cowpox, a mild disease from cows, never seemed to get smallpox. To test his idea, he decided to inoculate a young boy, deliberately placing material from a cowpox sore into a small cut on his arm. When the boy was later exposed to smallpox, he stayed healthy. This experiment led to the first vaccine and, almost two centuries later, to the complete elimination of smallpox.

comprehension_question.question_text: What did Jenner notice about milkmaids?

options.text: Those who had cowpox did not get smallpox

comprehension_question.evidence_snippet: milkmaids who had caught cowpox, a mild disease from cows, never seemed to get smallpox
comprehension_question.why_correct: Metin "milkmaids who had caught cowpox ... never seemed to get smallpox" diyor; inek çiçeği geçiren sağıcılar çiçek hastalığına yakalanmıyordu.

comprehension_question_2.question_text: In the text, the word "inoculate" most likely means:

options.text: to put a small amount of a disease into the body to protect it
to give someone medicine to drink

comprehension_question_2.evidence_snippet: deliberately placing material from a cowpox sore into a small cut on his arm
comprehension_question_2.why_correct: "inoculate" = aşılamak; ipucu: "placing material from a cowpox sore into a small cut on his arm" — hastalık maddesini bilerek küçük bir kesiğe koymak.

paragraph_raw: People living on certain Greek and Italian islands are famous for reaching old age in good health. Their traditional diet is based on vegetables, beans, fish and olive oil, with very little red meat or sugar. They are also abstemious eaters, stopping before they feel full and rarely drinking more than a single glass of wine with dinner. Researchers believe that this moderation, together with strong family ties and daily physical work, explains much of their long life.
